title: Non-Disappearance of Nonnegative Scalar-Curvature Limits
exact_target: Can positive-volume regions disappear in limits of nonnegative-scalar-curvature manifolds without interior minimal surfaces?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30002149 (OWR-12009-006). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Mathematical Aspects of General Relativity (2012), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2012/37, pp. 2269--2333. Primary report accessed 2026-10-11; relevant PDF pages 50, 51.
Sormani, scalar curvature and intrinsic-flat convergence (catalogue-listed context; not independently consulted in this preparation).

status_qualification: The convergence topology was recovered as intrinsic flat convergence (PDF page 50). The source reports non-disappearance under additional nonnegative-Ricci-curvature or uniform-contractibility assumptions; these are partial cases, not replacements for the scalar-curvature target.
